subject: DPA redlines: erase window, backups, and geolocation language
messages:
From: Anna Jones <anna.jones@fintrupay.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: DPA redlines — erase window & onshore copy language

Hi Evelyn,

Attached are our initial DPA redlines for the pilot account. Two items are blocking Legal sign-off today:

1) Erasure window — we need contractual language that guarantees customer-initiated erasure of data (including backups) is completed within 30 days.

2) Data residency — we require onshore processing for customer data classified as PII for the US and for EU customers we expect onshore (EU region) processing and proof that copies remaining in backups will be erased or rendered inaccessible within the same 30-day window.

We understand that backup retention and overwrite patterns can be complicated — please confirm how Redwood handles immutable backups and whether you can commit to a maximum time-to-erase for all copies. Our legal team also asked for a deletion certification to be issued after the final wipe.

I've attached FintruPay_DPA_Redlines_v1.docx with inline comments. Can someone from Redwood legal/infra propose alternate language if 30 days isn't feasible for backups?

Thanks,
Anna Jones
Head of Security, FintruPay
anna.jones@fintrupay.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: FintruPay_DPA_Redlines_v1.docx (docx)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Jones <anna.jones@fintrupay.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DPA redlines — erase window & onshore copy language

Anna — thanks for the clear notes and the redline doc. We reviewed with infra + legal and wanted to surface options so we can land on contract language that matches operational realities. High-level responses below; detailed redline attached (RI_DPA_response_v2.docx).

Summary of constraints and options:

- Primary data erasure: We can commit to deleting customer data from primary stores within 30 calendar days after a validated deletion request.
- Backups and immutable snapshots: For a standard hosted deployment, backups are on rolling snapshot schedules. Backups are overwritten on a retention cycle (configurable), but guaranteed physical overwrite of every sector in replicated cold backups can exceed 30 days.
- Certificate of deletion: We can provide a signed attestation that primary stores were deleted and provide logs showing backup retention windows and the overwrite schedule.

Proposed compromise language (we included in RI_DPA_response_v2.docx):
- "Redwood will delete customer data from primary production stores within thirty (30) calendar days of a validated deletion request. For backups, Redwood will ensure that copies are made inaccessible and scheduled for overwrite within ninety (90) calendar days from the deletion request; upon completion Redwood will provide a written certification of deletion. If customer requires a shorter backup erasure period, Redwood will evaluate Dedicated or Private deployment options (onshore-only processing) to meet that SLA."

Options we are happy to discuss on a call:
1) Accept the above compromise (primary 30 / backup 90 + cert).
2) Sign a Dedicated/Private deployment addendum with an agreed shorter backup overwrite SLA.
3) Agree to an escrow / trusted third-party verification step for specific records if you need contractual proof beyond our attestation.

Next steps: if that language looks acceptable, we can incorporate it into your draft DPA and push a tracked redline tonight. If not, let us know which specific portions are non-starters and we'll bring infra/architects into a quick call.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of GTM Security, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com
+1 (650) 555-0199

Attachment: RI_DPA_response_v2.docx (docx)

From: FintruPay Legal <legal@fintrupay.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anna Jones <anna.jones@fintrupay.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DPA redlines — erase window & onshore copy language

Evelyn,

Thanks for the quick reply and the suggested compromise. A few clarifications from our side after reviewing RI_DPA_response_v2.docx:

- 90 days for backups is longer than our acceptable risk posture. We need a contractual maximum of 45 days for making backups inaccessible and a certification within 10 business days of the overwrite completing.
- For EU customer data we need a binding commitment that processing and storage of personal data will only occur in EU-located infrastructure (we are not comfortable with a soft "prefer EU" clause).
- We also require regular retention logs to be retained for at least 12 months to support audits; please confirm retention of audit logs and whether Redwood will provide access for compliance sampling.

If Redwood cannot meet the 45-day backup SLA for hosted customers, we will need either: (A) an agreement to Dedicated capacity with a defined overwrite schedule, or (B) a specific escrow arrangement to guarantee deletion.

We appreciate the options you listed — please confirm whether the 45-day backup SLA is achievable under any configuration and provide the technical control descriptions we can include as an appendix (snapshots, replication, overwrite policy, certification process). Attached are our inline comments (FP_legal_comments.pdf).

Regards,
FintruPay Legal
legal@fintrupay.com

Attachment: FP_legal_comments.pdf (pdf)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: FintruPay Legal <legal@fintrupay.com>, Anna Jones <anna.jones@fintrupay.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 16:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DPA redlines — erase window & onshore copy language

Thanks — appreciate the specificity, that helps. Below are concrete answers and the path I recommend to get you to signature quickly. Full tracked redline attached (DPA_redline_v3.docx).

Technical feasibility and recommended contract language:

1) Backup overwrite window: For our hosted (multi-tenant) offering we cannot guarantee a 45-day overwrite for *all* backup replicas due to replication and cross-region durability processes. Operational reality: some cold backups are retained to support disaster recovery and cross-region durability and are overwritten on a 90-day cadence by default.

2) Mitigations we can offer today:
- We will commit to making backups containing customer data inaccessible (logical deletion + key destruction) within 30 calendar days; the physical overwrite/overwrite-bytes on some cold replicas will occur within 90 days.
- We will provide a signed certification within 10 business days after the final overwrite completes.
- For EU-only residency and a 45-day physical overwrite SLA, we can support that via a Dedicated or Private deployment (onshore-only clusters) under an addendum with specific overwrite schedules and an operational runbook.
- Audit logs: we will retain retention and deletion logs (append-only) for 12 months and provide sampling access under NDA for audit purposes.

Suggested contract language (short form):
"Redwood will delete Customer Data from primary production systems within thirty (30) calendar days of Customer's validated deletion request. Redwood will make all Customer Data copies inaccessible within thirty (30) calendar days and will perform physical overwrite or destruction of backups within ninety (90) calendar days, after which Redwood will provide a written certification of deletion. For customers requiring stricter backup overwrite windows (including 45 days or less) Redwood offers Dedicated and Private deployment options; deployment-specific overwrite SLAs shall be documented in a mutually executed addendum."

Next steps I propose:
- Option A (fast path): FintruPay accepts the compromise language above, we incorporate into your DPA and sign.
- Option B (enterprise path): If you require 45-day physical overwrite and onshore-only processing, Redwood will provide a Dedicated/Private addendum quote; we'll schedule a short technical call with your infra and ours (Vivek) to align the runbook and then sign the addendum.

I'll also paste a short technical note below for your infra team to review. If that looks fine to you, let's schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow with Priyom, Vivek, and one of your infra leads and finalize the addendum language.

Technical note (brief):
- Primary deletes: immediate tombstone + KV purge.
- Backup snapshots: logical deletion occurs immediately; snapshots are retained until scheduled snapshot garbage collection runs.
- Key destruction: for encrypted backups, destruction of KMS keys renders snapshots unrecoverable and is an acceptable mechanism for logical-inaccessibility; physical sector overwrite timing still follows retention cycles.

Please let me know availability for a call. If you accept the compromise language I'll update the tracked DPA tonight.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Head of GTM Security, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com
+1 (650) 555-0199
